Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in League City, Texas, on one of the main roads near the shopping center. I was trying to move over one
lane because I needed to make a turn coming up.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I checked my mirror, saw what I thought was a clear lane, and started to change over. I was signaling, I'm pretty
sure of that. Then I felt a bump on the driver's side and heard scraping.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it made contact?
A: Not really. It was kind of in my blind spot, and I didn't catch it until the contact happened.
Q: Were you able to get your vheicle stopped safely afterward?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. My car was still drivable, but the side was pretty banged up.
Q: You mentioned an injury. Can you describe it?
A: My right knee hit the dashboard and the door frame when I jerked the wheel. It swelled up pretty quickly, and I've
had trouble bearing weight on it since.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment for the knee?
A: I went to urgent care that same afternoon, and I've got a follow-up scheduled with an orthopedist next week.
Q: Did anyone else ride in your vehicle at the time?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement before we finish?
A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm hoping this gets sorted out quickly, because I'm still having a hard time
getting around.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
